Title: Azure Cosmos DB: Run JavaScript and filter JSON data in the Azure portal

Body.Content:
The latest Azure Cosmos DB service update in the Azure portal contains the following changes:

  • Document Explorer: filter on documents to modify and delete specific documents
  • Script Explorer: save and run stored procedures
  • Default Scripts: get sample scripts for triggers, stored procedures, and user-defined functions

To learn more, go to:

  • Write, edit, and run SQL queries for Azure Cosmos DB using Query Explorer
  • Create and run stored procedures, triggers, and user-defined functions using the Azure Cosmos DB Script Explorer
